//: The scenarios (presets): what each one tests, where it works, what it asks for, and how to write one. Part of the documentation (site/data/docs.json), so English and Polish only. The list comes from site/data/presets.json, the program's own list of its presets, through the scenario_list token, and the example file from site/examples/presets/ through preset_example.

en.title: Chrono Mock scenarios - ready-made test dates, and writing your own
en.description: Every scenario (preset) that comes with Chrono Mock: the date it gives, what it tests, where it works and which values it asks for, and the file format for writing your own.

pl.title: Scenariusze Chrono Mock - gotowe daty testowe i własne pliki
pl.description: Każdy scenariusz (preset) dostarczany z Chrono Mock: jaką datę daje, co sprawdza, gdzie działa i o jakie wartości pyta, oraz format pliku, w którym zapiszesz własny.
